fields.statement: Which landed intent should change set 01M78T0 (A passing local gate is reused) serve? It saves ~20 min of ship-change wall time per run on gate days; the perf report says milestone 35 has no change set covering it. Its sibling 01M78RM (gate switches on only for repeated named flakes) serves m4-runs-hold-up. / What does a passing local gate get reused on: which tree must be unchanged for ship gate to pass at once without rerunning it? / How does the gate check only what the change touches while the product stays language-neutral?
